data.reasoning: The PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO are standard and contain no malicious code. The source is fetched from the official upstream repository with a pinned checksum. The disagreement was solely due to an API error in one of the models.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error when reviewing .SRCINFO, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The deepseek model successfully reviewed both files and correctly identified them as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: API errors for non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO should not necessarily force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the executable packaging files (PKGBUILD) are successfully audited and found safe.
Implement automatic retries for transient API errors to prevent incomplete audits and false inconclusive states.
